strings.text: Carloku is priced for convenience and fairness. Four plans covering hobbyists to pro teams.
strings.original: Four plans, priced per year in euro. Start on Free. Personal, Community and Business add room and continuous replication. Usage beyond the inclusions is billed monthly at published rates.

strings.text: Carloku is priced for convenience and fairness. Four plans covering hobbyists to pro teams.
strings.original: Four plans, priced per year in euro before VAT. Start on Free. When you want more room, pick a paid plan from your account's Billing page.

strings.text: Choose the plan that works best for you. CARLOS apps scale to zero when they're not in use. You only pay for the time that they're awake.
strings.original: Paid plans and usage billing are new on Carloku.

strings.text: Free to try, great for tiny apps.
strings.original: For trying Carloku, or for a small app you never want to pay for.

strings.text: Data stored on sleep. No data replication, no data restore.
strings.original: Your data is saved when an app sleeps. There is no continuous replication and no restore to an earlier moment.

strings.text: Apps not visited after 90 days are archived with notice. These apps can be restored later by request.
strings.original: An app nobody visits for 90 days is archived: its address stops answering and its data is kept, compressed, and restored on request. You get an email at 60 and 80 days. Nothing is ever deleted.

strings.text: For individuals running a few apps.
strings.original: For one person running a few apps.
Minimum 10 members, so €50 a year to start.

strings.text: For a groups, clubs, classes, an open-source projects.
strings.original: For a group sharing one account: a club, a class, an open-source project.

strings.text: Each member adds 17 awake hours a month
strings.original: Each member adds 17 awake hours a month

strings.text: Each member adds 0.5 GB of storage
strings.original: Each member adds 0.5 GB of storage

strings.text: Each member adds 0.4 GB of transfer a month
strings.original: Each member adds 0.4 GB of transfer a month
Minimum 10 members, so €500 a year to start.

strings.text: For teams that need continuous replication and restore.
strings.original: For teams that need continuous replication and restore.
Each member adds 170 awake hours a month

strings.text: 5 GB/m extra of storage per member
strings.original: Each member adds 5 GB of storage

strings.text: Each member adds 3 GB of transfer a month
strings.original: Each member adds 3 GB of transfer a month

strings.text: Each member adds 30,000 replication writes a month
strings.original: Each member adds 30,000 replication writes a month

strings.text: Continuous replication, with restore to an earlier moment
strings.original: Continuous replication, with restore to an earlier moment

strings.text: Paid plans are never archived. CARLOS apps typically wake in under 500ms.
strings.original: Paid plans are never archived, however quiet the app.

strings.text: Members are team members who can access and ship your sites and apps.
strings.original: A member is a person with access to the account in the console. People who use the apps you deploy are never counted and never priced.

strings.text: Inclusions are per member, per month. They are pooled across the account and do not roll over.
strings.original: Inclusions are per member, per month. They are pooled across the account and do not roll over.

strings.text: Prices are indexed to local affordability, using a World Bank price-level measure for your billing country. There are four bands.
strings.original: Prices are indexed to local affordability, using a World Bank price-level measure for your billing country. There are four bands.

strings.text: Band A pays the full price and gets the full inclusions.
strings.original: Band A pays the full price and gets the full inclusions.

strings.text: Band B pays 75% and gets 75% of the inclusions.
strings.original: Band B pays 75% and gets 75% of the inclusions.

strings.text: Ireland, the EU-15, the US, the UK, Australia and Canada are band A. Your billing country sets the band at checkout. Usage beyond the inclusions costs the same in every band.
strings.original: Ireland, the EU-15, the US, the UK, Australia and Canada are band A. Your billing country sets the band at checkout. Usage beyond the inclusions costs the same in every band.

strings.text: Checkout can show the price in your local currency. The euro price is what is charged.
strings.original: Checkout can show the price in your local currency. The euro price is what is charged.

strings.text: Extra usage is billed monthly, from our own usage statements.
strings.original: Usage beyond the pooled inclusions is billed monthly, from our own usage statements.

strings.text: Minimum €1 bill based on our own measures. If usage doesn't meet our metered amount, it's not billed for that month.
strings.original: A month under €1 is not billed. We bill only usage we measured completely. If our measurement of a meter is incomplete for a month, that meter is not billed for that month.

strings.text: Carloku is hosting (currently) on AWS. For files served directly from S3, we simply charge the AWS transfer fee.
strings.original: Apps can serve files straight from their storage bucket. For that transfer we count only what Amazon Web Services (AWS) charges us for. If that count is wrong, it is wrong in your favour.

strings.text: Use the code HALF at checkout for 50% off the subscription, forever. No form, no proof. The inclusions are not halved.
strings.original: Use the code HALF at checkout for 50% off the subscription, forever. No form, no proof. The inclusions are not halved.

strings.text: Your price is fixed for the year you bought. Rates and country bands are reviewed once a year, in public. Any tightening applies to new subscriptions only. Existing accounts keep the deal they signed up for until they choose to change it.
strings.original: Your price is fixed for the year you bought. Rates and country bands are reviewed once a year, in public. Any tightening applies to new subscriptions only. Existing accounts keep the deal they signed up for until they choose to change it.

strings.text: Prices exclude value-added tax (VAT). VAT is added at checkout according to your billing country and shown before you pay. The merchant is Team Tito Limited, Dublin, Ireland.
strings.original: Prices exclude value-added tax (VAT). VAT is added at checkout according to your billing country and shown before you pay. The merchant is Team Tito Limited, Dublin, Ireland.

strings.text: You pay by card through Stripe. From your account's Billing page you can change your card, download invoices and cancel. Cancelling keeps the plan running until the end of the year you paid for.
strings.original: You pay by card through Stripe. From your account's Billing page you can change your card, download invoices and cancel. Cancelling keeps the plan running until the end of the year you paid for.

strings.text: Adding a member to Community or Business charges the rest of the current year for that member straight away, prorated to the day. A member who leaves comes off the bill at renewal.
strings.original: Adding a member to Community or Business charges the rest of the current year for that member straight away, prorated to the day. A member who leaves comes off the bill at renewal.

strings.text: We keep no card details, billing name or billing address on our side.
strings.original: We keep no card details, billing name or billing address on our side.

strings.text: Create an account at console.carloku.com. You sign in with a passkey through Keymail, so there is no password. Every new account starts on Free, and no card is needed. When you want more, open your account's Billing page, choose a plan and pay.
strings.original: Create an account at console.carloku.com. You sign in with a passkey through Keymail, so there is no password. Every new account starts on Free, and no card is needed. When you want more, open your account's Billing page, choose a plan and pay.
